units.source_text: 阿泷像抱着一捆蔬菜似的把阿雪抱起来，走过桥对面的踏石。

en.t: Ataki lifted Ayuki as if he were carrying a bundle of vegetables, and crossed the stepping stones on the far side of the bridge.

units.source_text: 这一座桥通向溪流中的小岛。

en.t: This bridge led to a small island in the mountain stream.

units.source_text: 岛上兴建了水榭，构成旅馆的庭院。

en.t: A waterside pavilion had been built on the island, forming part of the inn's garden.

units.source_text: 月光犹如成群的银色候鸟行将淹没似的，洒落在四周的深水里。

en.t: Moonlight fell into the deep water all around, as though flocks of silver migratory birds were about to sink beneath it.

units.source_text: 岩石的莹白，同对岸杉林的秋虫啁啾浑然一体，逼近她那赤裸的身体。

en.t: The gleaming whiteness of the rocks blended with the chirring of autumn insects in the cedar woods across the water, and pressed close upon her naked body.
